concerns.text: FR-001 (and other FRs) reference IDs like "US-1", "US-2", "US-3" (e.g., "(See US-1)") but no such IDs are defined elsewhere in the document. Cross‑references should resolve to an existing identifier or be removed/renamed.

The primary actor is called a "researcher" in the user stories, while the surrounding sections use the generic term "user" (e.g., "User Scenarios & Testing"). Consistent terminology for the same role should be used throughout to avoid confusion.
